name: Stolen Scroll
description: The scroll that recorded the secret story of Konoha Village is lost. 3rd Fire Master wants you to find it ASAP. And it cannot be in hands of other village.
guideBefor: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Komaru # in Novice Village to check clues of the scroll
guideEnd: Find #Komaru# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: A note scroll has lost! Go ask Komaru if he has taken the note scroll.
talkEnd: No, I didn't take it. Grandpa, I will change your opinion of me. I will become a Hokage by myself!

name: Find Scroll
description: What kind of secret story recorded in the scroll that makes 3rd Fire Master so anxious?
guideBefor: Find #Komaru#  in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find the lost scroll at  #Village Entrance #
guideEnd: Find #Komaru# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Not long ago, I saw a man with a big scroll enters the village secretly, can you check it out?
talkEnd: Found it? Haha, I'm the most informed person in the village.

name: Return Scroll
description: Story in the note scroll.
guideBefor: Find #Komaru#  in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #3rd Fire Master # in Novice Village give the scroll to him
guideEnd: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: It's the missing note scroll! Let’s give it back to grandpa! Seems it records a story.
talkEnd: Oh, thanks to you, the note scroll is back. Let me tell you the story in this scroll.

name: Demon is Back
description: Saitou Hiroto has come back to the village! What's for?
guideBefor: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Go to  #Secluded Path # and resist foreign invasion
guideEnd: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Boy, that thing is not as simple as you think... What? Foreign invaders! And they have arrived at the Secluded Path? Let's go for a look.
talkEnd: So, you're talking about Hiroto. He is not a born genius. But, unfortunately…he has betrayed our village.

name: Find Ishida
description: Ishida is not in the village now, go find him ASAP!
guideBefor: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Kazaki has encountered a little trouble in his escort mission, he needs an assistance team now. Now you are the team leader. Find Ishida and go to Kazaki's place.
talkEnd: Kazaki is around the Haruto Bridge. Go find him now, I will be right there later.

name: Haruto Bridge
description: Get ready and go to Haruto Bridge.
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Here you come. This escort mission is no longer a normal D mission. You must be careful! Go explore the path first.
talkEnd: Hi, kids, I'm coming. You're strong now! From now on, I'm your teammate. Ahead to Haruto Bridge now!

name: Mission Upgraded
description: This escort mission is no longer a normal D-rank mission...
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: The enemy is too much. It's definitely not a normal mission. I have to reconsider it. You go and explore the Ripple Lake first.
talkEnd: Be careful! It is a S mission now! Let's move on.

name: Land of Waves
description: The land of waves is near, hope everything goes well.
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Ripple Lake is near. Hope everything goes well.
talkEnd: It's too quiet. Stay alert.

name: Mori Kira's Salvation
description: A masked youngster took away Mori Kira's body…But something is wrong
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: How could a S-Rank missing-nin shows up here? You guys, be careful! I have to fight Mori Kira.
talkEnd: Who is that youngster that took Mori Kira's body away? Now we can have a rest.

name: Sora's Nightmare
description: Sora's Nightmare. The doom day of his clan, the change of his brother…
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Go to  #Uchiha's Adytum # to gather information of Uchiha Clan's extermination
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hi, you! Don't do anything bad with the Scroll given by Kazaki Sensei, or I won't let you off!
talkEnd: What did you see just now? Hum! Move on!

name: Speed
description: Hara is dominating the battle in the ice mirror.
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Isn't he dead? That masked youngster is so fast. This time I must see through his movement.
talkEnd: Sora! Why do you take that for me…Hurry up, Sora needs treatment.

name: Nine Tails
description: Haruto finally awakened! Haruto got raged when he saw Sora is beaten down by Hara. The power of nine-tailed fox broke out.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I won't forgive you! Hara, I will kill you! Help me at the Haruto Bright (1).
talkEnd: Hara, Mori Kira is a bad guy, why are you doing this for him? Why?

name: The Late Partner
description: The third teammate has arrived.
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Kazaki # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: So, you're the other member from the assistance team? Turns out, it's a boy from the Inuzuka.
talkEnd: Not bad! You and Inuzuka Inuba work very well.

name: Strength Upgraded
description: The power of the team is enhanced when the third teammate joined in.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Lead Inuzuka Inuba to #Haruto Bridge (2) # to start training
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: With Inuzuka Inuba, our team is more powerful.
talkEnd: Now, lead your team! Take care of Sora and Haruto! I will handle Mori Kira.

name: A boy as pure as snow
description: Haruto finally defeat Hara. Hara asks Haruto to kill him.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Kazaki # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hara is such a kind boy! I don't understand why he follows Mori Kira!
talkEnd: The kid, he jumped in to protect Mori Kira!

name: Emotional Outburst
description: Haruto's story awakens Mori Kira's feeling for Hara, and he swears to kill Gato
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Help Mori Kira to take revenge at  #Haruto Bridge (3) #
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Go to the Haruto Bridge (3) to help Mori Kira!
talkEnd: The mission is over! You've grown up. You're qualified for the Chunin Test.

name: Death Forest
description: Into the Death Forest!
guideBefor: Find #Miki# in Novice Village and talk with her
guide: Resist the enemy's attack in  #Death Forest #
guideEnd: Find #Miki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hey, you! Stop running around. Here is more dangerous than it looks.
talkEnd: All right. Fine, I'll give you a chance for the Chunin Test. But don't die in there.

name: Chunin Exam
description: Qualification of Chunin test obtained!
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Haruto # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Ok! Now, let's find Sora first. We have to know the rules of the exam first.
talkEnd: You’re here in the Death Forest too.

name: Snake's Pupil
description: Haruto and his team encounter Hydra in the forest.  And get attacked by the sound ninjas.
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: No matter who you are, if you can't answer the code you will be my enemy!
talkEnd: Hydra!? What he have done to me! Ouch!

name: Faith of Love
description: At this time the 'Konoha's Beautiful Green Wild Beast' Lee appears. In order to protect Sasaki, he has made up his mind to defeat those sound ninjas.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Lee, he has no chance to protect girls if I were there…
talkEnd: I never though Lee would have such a powerful technique! But these Ninjas still can defeat him! Sora is waking up.

name: Curse seal Activated
description: Suddenly, Sora's cursed seal is activated!
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Who did that to Sasaki? Who is it? I will kill him!
talkEnd: I feel power is overflowing within my body. Now, let's grab the scroll and pass the exam!

name: Grab Scroll
description: In order to pass the exam, Haruto and his team have to grab other team member's scroll.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Grad a scroll from the enemy in #Jungle (1) #
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Till now, we haven't got any scroll. Let's go to the Jungle (1) and grab other ninja's scroll! Hurry up!
talkEnd: Ah!? You've got a scroll?

name: Forest Tower
description: Forest Tower. The terminal of the second test.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Come on, let's go! We're running out of time. If we can't get to the Forest Tower, we will fail!
talkEnd: Hi, be alert! You may get ambushed on the way.

name: Ninjas' Obstruction
description: To enter the forest tower is not that easy! You have to defeat the team waiting out of there!
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Pass through #Jungle (3) # and reach to the forest tower
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I can see the Forest Tower now. Keep alert. I think there are more ninjas hidden in front of the tower.
talkEnd: Too many of them, I can't take it anymore. Go!

name: All Pass
description: Finally get to the Forest Tower
guideBefor: Find #Gale# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Gale # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Gale# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hi, I 'm Gale Gekko. I will in charge of the next judicial work. Time is up, the team that can't finish it on time will fail the test.
talkEnd: Congratulations! All of you have passed the second test!

name: The Third Test
description: After the second test, there are too many remaining players.  So, the Hokage has decided to add an one on one fight.
guideBefor: Find #Gale# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Gale # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Gale# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Before the third test, I need you to do one thing which is related to the formal test selection.
talkEnd: Get ready and draw lots for the next one on one fighting. The winner will advance to the final match.

name: Fight Lin
description: Opponent is Lin.
guideBefor: Find #Gale# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Defeat Lin in the  #Forest tower # to get qualified for the final test
guideEnd: Find #Gale# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Cough…Your opponent is Lin from Yuuhi Koyama's team! If you win, you can enter the final match!
talkEnd: You are the winner! Congrats! Now, I declare the third test ended!

name: Summoning Jutsu
description: Haruto find you a teacher--Jun
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find Iraiya at  #Cliff # and learn the summoning jutsu
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Haha…Pervert senin is going to teach me some powerful ninjutsu! Come with me!
talkEnd: Ahahaha…How can I summon a big toad rather than a tadpole? I have to master it before the final match.

name: Final Test
description: Gario's shield vs. Sora's spear, which one is more powerful? But at this very moment, the sand ninja's has start their action.
guideBefor: Find #Gario# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Help Sora and defeat Gario in  #Conference Hall (1) #
guideEnd: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hee hee! Uchiha Sora, the final match will start soon. His blood must be very tasty.
talkEnd: Kazekage! He wants to start a war! How dare you are…

name: Ancient Warriors
description: Hydra summoned out the first and second Hokage using the Reanimation. The battle among the three Hokages have started.
guideBefor: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I Won't forgive you, Hydra! Come on!
talkEnd: And now, I will use the Fourth Hokage's jutsu! Please make some time for me.

name: Reaper Death Seal
description: Finally 3rd Fire Master summoned the God of Death and sealed the first and second Hokage's soul.
guideBefor: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I will use the S. Ability: Reaper Death Seal. Please make some time for me.
talkEnd: I can kill Hydra, but I can seal his two hands. In this way he will unable to use ninjutsu anymore!

name: The Death of 3rd Fire Master
description: This greatest Hokage has died at hands of his apprentice
guideBefor: Find #3rd Fire Master# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Haruto # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I know my life is going to the end after using the Reaper Death Seal. Kid, you will become a great ninja. Hydra will come back to the village, and that time the village is depended on you.
talkEnd: Third Hokage…I must stop those Sand ninjas! Let's go and find Sora.

name: Light and Darkness
description: Killing is the only thing that can make Gario feels his is still existent. The battle between Gario and Sora is started.
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I must stop Gario. You come with me.
talkEnd: I remember that look! That murderous look is just the same as I saw it in the examination hall. Be careful...

name: Beyond the Limits
description: Facing Gario's Shukaku, completed form, Haruto summoned out Gama Bunta.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: You are my partners! If Gario is hurting you, I will him for sure!
talkEnd: My body is too heavy, I can't take it…

name: Crisis Solved
description: Hydra is defeated through a tough battle, but the village is ruined so everyone in the Konoha village is engaged in the reconstruction work now.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Kazaki # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Is the war over? Let's go back to the village.
talkEnd: Finally, it's over! We need to rebuild the village.

name: Return of Demon
description: Meanwhile, two strangers appears in the village. And they are Saitou Hiroto and Kimura Hoshigaki!
guideBefor: Find #Ebisi# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Kazaki # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Two strangers come to the village at such a time! We got to be careful.
talkEnd: Ah?! Two strangers? They are in the tea shop few minutes ago. Who are they?

name: Kekkei Genkai
description: Saitou Hiroto who possesses the Kekkei Genkai -Sharingan is regarded as the most powerful Sharingan user. Will Kazaki win the battle against Hiroto?
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Those eyes…Mangekyou Sharingan!! That man is Saitou Hiroto! You must be careful!
talkEnd: Saitou Hiroto! Come to the village? ! Damn! I will kill him! If you don't want to go with me, just get out of here...

name: Chidori's Whisper
description: When thinking about the the miserable past, Sora went to Haruto and decided to kill Hiroto for his parents and clan…
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Saitou Hiroto, I'm waiting for this day! I'm going to kill him!
talkEnd: Saitou Hiroto! Why can't I kill him?

name: Hiroto's Target
description: They come here for the nine-tailed fox's power that sealed in Haruto.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Jun # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Jun# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hiroto! He come back for what?
talkEnd: I won't let you take away Haruto, unless you defeat me!

name: Wall of Flesh
description: Jun suddenly shows up when Kimura Hoshigaki almost kill Haruto. Hiroto's target is Haruto! Jun won't allow them to take away Haruto.
guideBefor: Find #Jun# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Jun# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: They are now in my stomach Let's see what they can do now!
talkEnd: Escaped? The wall of flesh was broken by them! What is that dark flame?

name: The Fifth Hokage
description: Jun finds Tona, and tell her about the invitation that the village elders want her to be the Fifth Hokage
guideBefor: Find #Jun# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Tona # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Tona# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hey, you! Call Haruto, I will take you to find a beauty!
talkEnd: The Fifth Hokage! If Haruto can master Rasengan in one week, I will take the title of fifth Hokage! And I will give him this necklace that left by the first Hokage.

name: Start of Training
description: Haruto couldn't bear Tona's saying that all the Hokages are foolish. He fought with Tona and made the promise that he can master the Rasengan in 3 days. Tona also promised him if he could master this jutsu in one week, she will give the first Hokage's necklace which is valuable for her to Haruto.
guideBefor: Find #Jun# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Haruto # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: That necklace is belonged to the first Hokage, if you sold it you could buy three mountains.
talkEnd: I must master that Rasengan jutsu!

name: Rasengan
description: Haruto mastered the S. Ability: Rasengan!
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and talk with him
guide: Defeat  #Stake of Taijutsu # that has  #Grasped S.Ability #
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I will Grasp S.Ability: Rasengan. Will you go with me?
talkEnd: Oh, yeah! I have mastered it!

name: Evil Deal
description: Hydra and Kabuto suddenly show up in front of Tona and Sayaka. Because his hands are injured in the battle with 3rd Fire Master, he wants her to cure him. He knows Tona very well, so he wants to make a deal with Tona that if she could cure his hands, he will revive her beloved two men.
guideBefor: Find #Tona# in Novice Village and talk with her
guide: Find  #Haruto # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Novice Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Yes, I miss my brother and Dan, I want to see their smiling faces again…But I won't treat Hydra's arms even if he can revive my brother and Dan.
talkEnd: Grandma Tona will not accept his request! Now, I'm going to find Sora, he ran away after fighting with me.

name: Sound Four Ninjas
description: Sora couldn't bear the fact that Haruto's power has surpassed him and his feeling of revenge is even stronger than before. At this time, the sound four appear…
guideBefor: Find #Sora# in Novice Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Sora# in Konoha Village  and submit mission
talkBefor: I'm not in a good mood. Good, I can kick these Hydra's men to vent.
talkEnd: I have decided! I'll look for Hydra. Whoever stops me, I will kill him.

name: Reason
description: The village is surrounded by many Sound ninja! The fifth Hokage gives the order to check it out.
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Check out why Sora is leaving the village and tell me.
talkEnd: To become a strong man?! I just asked someone to stop Sora. Go help them now!

name: Butterfly Attack
description: Shimizu made a decision, that divided the team into two groups, a group to chase Sora, the other group to stop the Jirobo team.  Choji chose to stay to stop the Jirobo team alone.
guideBefor: Find #Kazaki# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Choji is fighting against Jirobo in the Wood Forest (1), go help him.
talkEnd: I think it would be ok for Choji to stop that Sound ninja.

name: Danger
description: Those sound ninjas never thought Haruto would break through Jirobo's defense and caught up  with them. Shimizu pretended to one from the Jirobo team and met with the sound ninjas.  Haruto was trapped by Kidomaru's Spider Sticky Gold...
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Kazaki # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Kazaki# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Choji's injured badly, take him to Kazaki Sensei. I will keep looking for Sora.
talkEnd: I will take care of Choji. You, go catch up with Haruto!

name: Emergency
description: You have to help them one by one.
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guide: Defeat the  #Sound Ninja Raider # in  #Konoha Jungle #
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: We keep moving on, you catch up with us after you finished those Sound ninjas!
talkEnd: You follow? Let's move on!

name: Focus on one Strike
description: The battle between Kidomaru and Hoshino Nao has started…
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Hoshino Nao has been blocked by Kidomaru at Konoha Jungle (1) , go help him!
talkEnd: Damn! How could the powerful Hoshino Nao be beaten like this, take him to Tona!

name: Endangered
description: Hoshino Nao found his gentle fist could defeat Kidomaru after fighting with him. But, in the mean time, Kidomaru summoned a huge spider with countless small spiders to attack Hoshino Nao. Hoshino Nao, in response, used his Byakugan to avoid the attacks. But, Kidomaru inadvertently discovered something...
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guide: Find  #Tona # in Novice Village and submit mission
guideEnd: Find #Tona# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: The wound…If you come here later, he will be a dead man for sure.
talkEnd: I'll treat him. Haruto has sent message to us, you can go to them!

name: Olfaction
description: Finally,  Haruto, Shimizu, Inuzuka Inuba and Akamaru formed a team.  Haruto and Inuzuka Inuba decided to take action at night since they couldn't catch up with those sound ninjas.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guide: Defeat the  #Sound Ninja's Brain # in  #Eastern Woods #
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Haruto just sent a message to us. He told us that Inuba was fell down the cliff with the Sound ninja. Let's go there ASAP.
talkEnd: He should be around. Keep looking!

name: Orc vs. Beast
description: Inuba, Akamaru and Sakon fell into the valley!
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: I found them! Inuba and that Sound ninja are ahead! Let's go.
talkEnd: This Sound ninja is too strong! Thanks God, Inuba is fine.

name: Life and Death Competing
description: Inuba and Akamaru has tried everything to fight Sakon. But at this time another enemy has showed up who is Sakon's brother Ukon. To defeat these them, Inuba and Akamaru decided using their new technique.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Let's move on. The Sound ninjas are waiting ahead.
talkEnd: I have spent too much time on these Sound ninjas, I have to find Haruto right now.

name: Wisdom Matches
description: Shimizu is captured by the Kidomaru. It's battle of wisdom..
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ebisi# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Sora is taken away by a sound ninja, I must chase him. Please help me stop that sound ninja called Tayuya.
talkEnd: I will take care of Shimizu. You, go catch up with Haruto!

name: Late Container
description: On the other hand, Haruto has encountered Tayuya. As they were about to strike back, a strange person appeared before Haruto…
guideBefor: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: You are coming just in time. This guy is so strong. Be careful!
talkEnd: Sora is in that bucket, I must bring him back.

name: Strength Gap
description: Haruto's shadow clones has been beaten down one by one by Kawakami, but he even couldn't touch his hair.  The worse thing is that Sora has come out from the bucket and about to leave.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Let's drive away those sound ninjas and help Haruto.
talkEnd: They are really hard to deal with.

name: Sound Ninja Obstruction
description: So many sound ninjas around the village.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Haruto# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Ok, let's go and help Haruto!
talkEnd: Kawakami's Ninjutsu is so weird, seems he has the Kekkei Genkai.

name: Pale Blue Beast
description: Suddenly, Lee comes up to Haruto, so Haruto get chance to chase Sora.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guideEnd: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and submit mission
talkBefor: Finish those sound ninjas first! And then deal with that Kawakami!
talkEnd: Lee has come here? Is he OK?

name: Sand Ninja
description: At this moment, Gario comes to help them.
guideBefor: Find #Ishida# in Konoha Village and talk with him
guide: Defeat the  #South Sanctum Sound Ninja # in  #Wood Grassland (2) #
